evidence.reason: `_timer_schedule_seconds` computes the completion/repeat bound only from `OnCalendar`, `OnUnitActiveSec`, `OnUnitInactiveSec` and `AccuracySec` (line 403: `overall = max(intervals) + accuracy`, accuracy defaulting to 60s). It never reads `RandomizedDelaySec=`, which systemd applies as an additional random delay to timer activations. A timer template declaring `RandomizedDelaySec=` therefore yields an understated maximum: the true gap to the next healthy activation can exceed the computed bound by up to the configured value, and preflight can admit a deadline the system cannot meet. This is an ordinary correctness gap in the stated purpose of the function (returning the overall bound), not a new requirement. The smallest compatible fix is to read `RandomizedDelaySec` in the `[Timer]` section and add its maximum value to `overall`/`repeat_bound` (or refuse such timers).
